Grok Imagine FAQ

Is Grok Imagine on Lanta AI free?

Yes. New users on Lanta AI get 40 free credits to try Grok AI video generation. Since the xAI Imagine API is paid, Grok Imagine Video costs credits based on video length and resolution.

How long can Grok Imagine videos be?

Grok Imagine videos can be 1 to 15 seconds long through the API. On some third-party platforms or websites, the available video length may be shorter depending on the mode, plan, or usage limits.

How do I make longer videos with Grok Imagine?

Do not try to make a full long video in one prompt. Break the idea into short shots. Generate one 5–10 second scene at a time, use the last frame or video extension to continue the story, then edit the clips together in a video editor.

Does Grok Imagine support image-to-video?

Yes. Grok Imagine can turn a still image into a video. You can upload a source image, such as a product shot, portrait, landscape, anime image, or concept art, and add a prompt describing how you want the scene to move.

Does Grok Imagine support reference images?

Yes. Grok Imagine supports reference images for video generation. The API allows up to 7 reference images in one request. When using reference images, label each image clearly in your prompt, such as “Image 1 is the character,” “Image 2 is the outfit,” and “Image 3 is the background.”

Why does Grok Imagine change my character?

This often happens when the prompt is too broad or the reference images are not clearly explained. Fast camera moves, complex actions, face turns, crowd scenes, and long shots can also make the character drift. Use a clear front-facing reference image, and keep the action simple.

Is Grok Imagine good for professional videos?

Grok Imagine is a strong tool for short creative videos, social media clips, and early marketing ideas. But it is not a full replacement for a professional video production.

Is Grok Imagine safe for real people’s photos?

Yes. Lanta AI keeps uploaded photos private and does not publicly share your images. Use real people’s photos only when you have permission. Avoid prompts that create misleading, sexual, harmful, or private depictions of a real person.

faq.answer: Yes. Grok Imagine supports reference images for video generation. The API allows up to 7 reference images in one request. When using reference images, label each image clearly in your prompt, such as “Image 1 is the character,” “Image 2 is the outfit,” and “Image 3 is the background.”

Does Grok Imagine support reference images?

Yes. Grok Imagine supports reference images for video generation. The API allows up to 7 reference images in one request. When using reference images, label each image clearly in your prompt, such as “Image 1 is the character,” “Image 2 is the outfit,” and “Image 3 is the background.”

faq.question: Why does Grok Imagine change my character?
faq.answer: This often happens when the prompt is too broad or the reference images are not clearly explained. Fast camera moves, complex actions, face turns, crowd scenes, and long shots can also make the character drift. Use a clear front-facing reference image, and keep the action simple.

faq.question: Is Grok Imagine good for professional videos?
faq.answer: Grok Imagine is a strong tool for short creative videos, social media clips, and early marketing ideas. But it is not a full replacement for a professional video production.

faq.question: Is Grok Imagine safe for real people’s photos?
faq.answer: Yes. Lanta AI keeps uploaded photos private and does not publicly share your images. Use real people’s photos only when you have permission. Avoid prompts that create misleading, sexual, harmful, or private depictions of a real person.
